patterns.transformation_opportunities:
1. Data Structure Consolidation
- The program defines two overlapping record structures (DIPWCC00-DATA and DIPWCC00-DATA-R)
- This REDEFINES pattern was common in COBOL for memory optimization but needs modern treatment

2. Type Conversion
- All fields are defined as PIC X (character) types
- Several fields clearly represent dates, times, and numeric values

1. Data Structure Modernization
- The COBOL record layout can be transformed into a proper Java class
- The PIC clauses indicate specific data types that need proper Java equivalents
- The level-88 condition names can be transformed into boolean methods
